description: This file defines the LLMClientCache class, a subclass of InMemoryCache, that manages cache keys by incorporating the current event loop identifier to prevent 'event loop closed' errors. It provides both synchronous and asynchronous methods for setting and retrieving cache entries.

classes.name: LLMClientCache
classes.description: A cache handler class that extends InMemoryCache, adding event loop-aware cache key management.

methods.name: update_cache_key_with_event_loop(self, key)
methods.description: Method that appends the current asyncio event loop's ID to the cache key to prevent errors due to closed event loops.

methods.name: set_cache(self, key, value, **kwargs)
methods.description: Synchronously sets a value in the cache after updating the cache key with event loop info.

methods.name: async_set_cache(self, key, value, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a value in the cache after updating the cache key with event loop info.

methods.name: get_cache(self, key, **kwargs)
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves a value from the cache after updating the cache key with event loop info.

methods.name: async_get_cache(self, key, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a value from the cache after updating the cache key with event loop info.
